# Jitter RNG health test vector: adaptive proportion test (APT), intermittent.
#
# Runs of 20 identical deltas of 500, each broken by one delta of another value
# (700 plus 37 more at every break). The APT counts how often the symbol its
# window opens on recurs within the window, and 20 of every 21 measurements
# are that symbol. The breaks keep the other tests quiet: a delta after a
# break differs from the one before it, so at most 19 measurements in a row
# are stuck, far below the RCT cutoff of 90 at osr 3; and a run of 19 correct
# predictions stays below the lag predictor's cutoffs, which a break then
# resets. Only the APT fires.
#
# 491 stamps, so 490 measurements, of which 467 open the window's symbol:
# past the APT cutoff of 459 at osr 3 and short of its permanent 479, and short
# as well of the 512 of an APT window, after which the next symbol opens a
# window of its own.
#
# One decimal time stamp per line. Replay with:
#   tests/health/health --replay <this file>
